description: This file defines the ProxyServer class with methods for creating, canonicalizing, and retrieving proxy server details, including handling schemes, host, and port.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Represents a proxy server with scheme, host, and port, providing methods for creation, comparison, and retrieval.

methods.name: ProxyServer::ProxyServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing scheme and host/port pair, with special handling for direct and invalid schemes.

methods.name: ProxyServer::FromSchemeHostAndPort
methods.description: Static method to create a ProxyServer from scheme, host, and port string or optional port.

methods.name: ProxyServer::GetHost
methods.description: Returns the host part of the proxy server as a string.

methods.name: ProxyServer::GetPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the proxy server.

methods.name: ProxyServer::host_port_pair
methods.description: Returns the host and port pair object.

methods.name: ProxyServer::GetDefaultPortForScheme
methods.description: Returns the default port number for a given scheme.
